notes.title: RAT IT EARLY ACCESS RELEASED!!!
notes.content:
Early Access Released
Hello everyone!

We are happy to say Rat it has official launch on Steam today! If you don't know anything about us or Rat it, don't forget to follow us on Twitter and Discord

Future Plan for Rat it

We will keep adding new content and improvement for Rat It. Hope you enjoy our game and give us feedback and review. The more you give us the better you can improve.

Thank you so much for your time. See ya!
